plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic subagents shared by every project (e.g. pr-reviewer) plus the universal standards layer the per-stack agents compose in. Install this alongside your stack plugin.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Subagents for Python projects: implements tasks test-first inside a Hexagonal Architecture, and reviews changes for correctness, security and architecture violations.

plugins.name: laravel
plugins.description: Subagents for Laravel projects: implements tasks test-first inside whatever architecture the repo already uses, and reviews changes separating real defects from costs the author may not have measured.

plugins.name: nodejs
plugins.description: Subagents for Node.js backend services: implements tasks test-first inside whatever framework and structure the repo already uses, and reviews changes separating real defects from costs the author may not have measured.

plugins.name: java
plugins.description: Subagents for Java backend services: implements tasks test-first inside whatever framework generation and structure the repo already uses, and reviews changes separating real defects from costs the author may not have measured.
